quests.title: Treasure in the Mountains!
quests.goal:
2000 Pts Before Time Over or
2000 Pts Plus Ltd Paw Pass
quests.details:
Gather the treasure that
lies sleeping in the field
to earn points. I will
calculate your total and
reward you based on how much
you can collect. Leave no
treasure undiscovered!
quests.fail:
Reward Zero or Gather Less
than 2000pts, Time Over
